Legend:
Level for first flood alert is overcome.
  First flood alert is announced when water stages in the river reach established treshold which is determined for every river section on the basis of hydrological-hydraulics studies, condition of embankments, vulnerability of defending area etc. Most frequently, that level matches the elevation of embankment base.
Level for second flood alert is overcome.
  Second flood alert is announced when water stages reach established treshold. Most frequently, that level is one meter below the embankment crown.
Change of water stage: 24 hour change
Tendency of water level:  water stage rising,  water stage falling,  water stage stagnation
